# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 16 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface-0, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface-0` | #ffffff | Tarjetas, pantallas y campos. |
| `--surface-50` | #f5f8fd | Fondo de la app detrás de las tarjetas. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #0f1f3d);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #0f1f3d;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #0f1f3d | Texto principal sobre surface-0 y surface-50. |
| `--ink-muted` | #5b6b86 | Texto secundario, metadatos y etiquetas de dato (5.4:1 sobre blanco). |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 28px/36px Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 28px / 36px | 600 | `sans` | Título de bienvenida y cifras grandes. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 20px / 28px | 600 | `sans` | Encabezado de pantalla o folio. |
| `subtitle` | `.subtitle`, `--text-subtitle` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` | Título de tarjeta. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Texto general. |
| `data` | `.data`, `--text-data` | 14px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Valor de un dato (folio, SKU, peso). |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Etiqueta del dato, metadatos. |
| `overline` | `.overline`, `--text-overline` | 11px / 14px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 600 | `sans` | Rótulos cortos en mayúsculas. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Ícono a texto. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Entre chips, dentro de filas. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Entre tarjetas en listas. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Relleno de tarjeta y margen de pantalla móvil. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Entre secciones. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Margen de página web. |
